title: GitHub Copilot Can Generate Your Entire App Blueprint (Most Developers Miss This)

chapters.title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code overview and basic use cases
Introduction to using Copilot for analyzing unfamiliar projects
Problem with traditional code analysis and Copilot solution
Copilot prompt design for app blueprint analysis
Subscription billing app functional areas and core features
User actions, APIs, reports, and business processes identified
Generating README documentation from Copilot analysis

features.name: GitHub Copilot inline suggestions in VS Code
features.description: GitHub Copilot provides inline code suggestions as developers write code in AL and other programming languages. Users can enable this feature in preferences by searching for 'next edit' and 'next suggestions'.

features.name: GitHub Copilot chat interface
features.description: GitHub Copilot includes a chat interface in VS Code where developers can interact with Copilot conversationally. The chat can be enabled via keyboard shortcut or from the menu.

features.name: GitHub Copilot agent mode for project analysis
features.description: GitHub Copilot can operate in agent mode to analyze entire AL projects and generate comprehensive documentation and blueprints. This mode uses Claude as the LLM for running analysis on loaded projects.

features.name: Copilot code refactoring assistance
features.description: GitHub Copilot can assist with refactoring code and functions, helping developers improve existing code structure and maintainability.

features.name: Copilot-generated AL object creation
features.description: GitHub Copilot can assist developers in creating smaller pieces of AL development including tables and pages.

features.name: App blueprint generation from project analysis
features.description: Copilot can analyze an AL app and generate a complete blueprint documenting functional areas, features, pages, actions, APIs, reports, and business processes in a structured format.
caveats: quality depends on project code clarity and structure

features.name: Markdown README generation from analysis
features.description: Copilot can convert the generated app blueprint and analysis into a properly formatted markdown README file that can be committed to GitHub or DevOps repositories.
